page.notes: Printed "per" appears as a small superscript above the line near "Lupum" in the first paragraph; left out as a probable correction mark, uncertain. Marks g, h, i and k are placed in the text where the scan shows them. The margin note k reads "de Ro." with the rest of the word cut off, so the expansion is doubtful. The h note "Baron.fnt." is uncertain, as is the "1" in "par.1" of note i. "Tesuafore" is hard to read: the long s may be f, so the word is marked [?]. The SECT. VIII. note stands beside the italic heading line and is placed inside that head element. Italics in the first paragraph (Lupum Ioh.20.non) are approximate. Watermark at bottom right is excluded.
